# Telehealth

## Requirements

- Consultation recordings must be destroyed once the clinical note is signed, as required by the Health Data Standard 6.

## Stories

- As a patient, I want the video of my visit deleted as soon as the doctor has signed off the write-up so that no copy lingers.
- As a patient, I want to share my documents before a visit so that the doctor has them.
- As a patient, I want to schedule a visit so that I can see a doctor from home.
